patch.value: The graph-shaping flags were previously reachable only through the exporter adapter alias, whose flattened CLI form drops option contracts (upstream pm-cli#574) — making shaping unusable from the CLI. Port them to the canonical `pm pm-graph export` with a zero-regression contract: calls without shaping flags stay byte-identical (full legacy graph, closed items included); once any shaping flag is used, closed/canceled items are excluded unless --include-closed. --output requires --format. Covered by new integration tests.
Canonical pm pm-graph export gains shaping flags (--output/--edges/--root/--depth/--filter/--include-closed)

Shaping flags shipped on canonical export with zero-regression default; --edges/--root/--depth/--filter/--include-closed/--output; integration tests cover deps-filtering, usage errors, and legacy byte-identical default.
